label: NHS Jobs
terms_note: NHS England vacancies; account application form.

endpoints.call: GET https://www.jobs.nhs.uk/api/v1/search_xml?keyword=… (public, keyless XML: vacancyDetails{id, reference, title, description, employer, type, salary, closeDate, postDate, url, locations[]}) can feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. No current developer documentation (the /api page is retired); the search_xml endpoint still answers without a key. Candidate terms and conditions opened — no bot clause surfaced in the extracted text; robots.txt empty. Applications require the NHS Jobs account (Applicant Hub).

adapter.terms: NHSBSA 'Self-Serve API (XML/RSS Feeds)': 'This feed allows employers to display NHS Jobs listings on their own websites or intranets' (NHS Jobs integration and benefits, https://www.nhsbsa.nhs.uk/about-nhs-jobs/nhs-jobs-integration-and-benefits); specification 'NHS Jobs Self-Serve Job Adverts API' v1.07 (01/05/2026, Word document linked from that page). 'Internal Only' adverts 'should only be available through your own intranet'. No rate limit is published; kept to one request per second.

search.note: Keyless XML endpoint 'https://www.jobs.nhs.uk/api/v1/search_xml?' (spec v1.07). keyword matches 'the job title and job advert text'; page is 1-based ('Each page contains a maximum of 10 vacancies, unless specified otherwise by the "limit" parameter'; limit 'Maximum value 100'). location is not sent because the spec requires it together with distance and countryCode - filter locations client-side. id is the job reference (use it with get_posting); the numeric id, closeDate, salary (a text range such as '£20,000 to £30,000'), type and locations are in raw. totalPages / totalResults are in the response wrapper. The endpoint answers 406 Not Acceptable to the runtime's default Accept: application/json (live check 2026-09-26), so adapter.headers sends Accept: application/xml.

get_posting.note: jobReference: 'limit responses to only those job adverts with a matching Job reference number. If provided, then no other filter parameters will be used. This is used for exact matching to a job advert.' Pass the id returned by search (the job reference, e.g. A3233-26-0001).

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify: the Self-Serve API is keyless and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the spec only retrieves adverts ('receive back live job adverts'); candidates apply on the advert's url.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging endpoint; the spec covers the search XML and RSS feeds and search links only.

live_check.notes: fixed: the API now answers 406 Not Acceptable to Accept: application/json; the adapter sends Accept: application/xml. The py/ts first-id difference is a posting published between the two runs (repeated requests return a stable order); all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
